denied_public_keys.reason: this file publishes the matching private seeds; these public keys authenticate nobody

materials.pending_meaning: true: a dispatch is pending and the document carries it; false: nothing is pending, the document is exactly the always keys

refused.reason: removed key roles (they come from the signed plan)
app_image is not the planned image
dispatch_id differs from the signed statement
target_ref differs from the signed statement
the signed plan digest is not the snapshot's
the signed product differs from the target
the binding names a primary service that is not an image
the binding names no primary service (no single-image fallback)
nothing pending but dispatch fields present

nonce_ledger.duplicate: refused; a retried POST carries a NEW nonce

note: Test keys come from fixed public seeds and carry no authority. `value_parts` are joined by the consumer so no secret-shaped literal sits in this file.

render_vectors.name: app_image sorts with the other lines (bytewise)
a secret-named material may point at a path
a secret-named material may not carry a value

refused.name: header target differs from the path
the credential is bound to another target
the credential looked up is not the one the request names
unsigned 403 is not a transport fault
a path that is not a target path

retry_idempotency.consume: dispatch id: a replay is 409 with the existing signed committed marker
retry_idempotency.lease/acquire: dispatch run: re-acquiring by the same run returns its lease
retry_idempotency.lease/release: dispatch run: a second release is a replay, not an error
retry_idempotency.observations: dispatch id plus kind: a repeat returns the stored receipt

target_binding.rule: the target ref is <product_code>/<environment>/<host> (Control's identities, signed and routed on). OpenBao names follow the approved <env>/<product> layout: the namespace is <secrets_environment>/<secrets_namespace> (prod/erp), the AppRole is <secrets_namespace>-<secrets_environment>-<role> (erp-prod-app), and the secret_ref is bao://<secrets_environment>/<secrets_namespace>/kv/<role>/<lower(name)>. secrets_namespace is a descriptor field; secrets_environment is fixed on the target at registration and never sent in a dispatch.
